conversation.text: Operators need to export the invoice list as CSV for accounting.

Qualification for EVAL-31, Export invoices as CSV.

What changes: the invoice page gets an "Export CSV" button; the file holds the paid and open invoices of the current filter.

Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: As an operator, I want an Export CSV button on the invoice page, so that I can take the list into a spreadsheet.
- AC2: As an operator, I want the file to hold only the paid and open invoices of the current filter, so that cancelled ones never reach accounting.

Out of scope: PDF export, scheduled exports, cancelled invoices.

Mara, is this what you need?

Spec summary for EVAL-31, Export invoices as CSV.

Design: an "Export CSV" button next to the invoice filter; the file has one row per paid or open invoice of the current filter, with number, customer, date, amount and status.

Acceptance criteria: AC1 and AC2 as agreed.

Decisions: cancelled invoices stay out (Mara Lind); the columns above (Mara Lind).

Mara, do you approve this spec?
